entities.name: Deguhe
entities.description: A graverobber in the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria with sharpened fingernails for tearing the clothes of the dead.

entities.name: Vervamon
entities.description: A figure who spied on Deguhe and tried to communicate with ghouls.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: A figure who spied on Deguhe with Vervamon and Quopomma.

entities.name: Quopomma
entities.description: A figure who spied on Deguhe with Vervamon and Maeveen O'Donagh.

entities.name: Offero
entities.description: Leader whose soldiers set up an ambush for Deguhe on behalf of the Inquisition.

entities.name: Inquisition
entities.description: A group whose interest was stirred when Vervamon engaged the ghouls.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where the Dark Age took place.

events.summary: Deguhe is digging up a fresh corpse when Vervamon, Maeveen O'Donagh and Quopomma spy on him.
events.quote: Deguhe was working on a victim

events.summary: Multiple ghouls converge on the site and Vervamon engages them, trying to communicate with them.
events.quote: Vervamon engaged them, trying to communicate with the creatures

events.summary: The Inquisition's interest is stirred and Offero's soldiers ambush the site, chasing Deguhe away.
events.quote: This stirred the interest of the Inquisition

relations.note: Offero's soldiers acted for the Inquisition.
relations.quote: Offero 's soldiers set up an ambush
